fields.label: Allow Ordering Out of Stock Items
Flat Shipping Rate
fields.description: Charged per order. Leave at zero for free shipping.

fields.label: Free Shipping Above
fields.description: Order value at which shipping becomes free.

fields.label: Shipping Account
fields.description: Income account used for the shipping charge on orders.

fields.label: Fulfillment Provider
fields.description: Who ships your orders. Providers are supplied by installed apps.
Comma-separated cities where Cash on Delivery is offered. Leave empty to allow every city.
fields.label: COD Allowed Cities

fields.description: Customers collect and pay at the store like cash on delivery. Shipping is waived for pickup orders.
fields.label: Enable Store Pickup

fields.description: Locations shown on checkout and the order confirmation page, with maps.
fields.label: Pickup Locations

fields.description: Checked automatically when a customer chooses Store Pickup at checkout. Leave empty to make shoppers pick one.
fields.label: Default Pickup Location

fields.description: Map shown for pickup locations. Both embeds are keyless — no API key or billing.
fields.label: Map Embed Provider
Auto-create Sales Invoices
fields.description: Submit an unpaid Sales Invoice the moment an order is placed. COD invoices stay unpaid until you click Mark paid; prepaid orders get settled by the gateway. Invoices are kept out of FBR e-invoicing until reviewed.

Offer a partial prepayment at checkout: the customer pays this percent or flat amount up front by scanning the Raast QR code, the order ships once you record it, and the courier collects the balance on delivery.
fields.label: Enable Advance Payment

fields.description: Compute the advance as a percent of the order total or as a flat amount.
fields.label: Advance Basis

fields.description: Offer Raast QR at checkout: the customer scans a code with their banking app and pays the full order total in one transfer. Needs a valid IBAN below before the method appears.
fields.label: Enable Raast QR

fields.description: The Raast IBAN the QR pays into, 24 characters (PK..). Checked on save, so a typo cannot ship a code pointing at the wrong account.
fields.label: Raast IBAN

fields.description: The account holder's name as the bank shows it. Shown next to the QR so the customer can confirm they are paying the right account.
fields.label: Raast Account Title

fields.description: Leave blank to name the bank from the IBAN itself (MEZN → Meezan Bank Limited). Type a name only when the confirmation page should say something else.
fields.label: Bank Name

fields.description: Shown at checkout only, before the order exists: say here that the QR code is generated once the order is placed. It is not repeated on the confirmation page or in the receipt email — by then the code is on screen.
fields.label: Advance Payment Instructions
Sync Coupons to POS
fields.description: Mirror Discounts-page coupons to POS Coupons so the same code works in POS Next. Turning this off leaves already-synced coupons in place.

fields.label: Sync POS Coupons to Storefront
fields.description: Mirror POS Coupons (Promotional) to Coupon Codes so the same code works on the storefront. Turning this off leaves already-synced coupons in place.

fields.label: Enable Fraud Check at Checkout
fields.description: Score every order against blacklists, velocity, address quality, city RTO rate, ordering time and device fingerprint.

fields.label: Advance Payment Score
fields.description: Orders scoring at or above this are switched from COD to online payment.

fields.label: Max Orders per Hour
fields.description: Orders from the same phone faster than this are blocked (COD).

fields.label: Risky Hour Start
fields.description: COD orders placed between this hour and Risky Hour End get extra scrutiny.

fields.label: Auto-blacklist After
fields.description: Failed or RTO deliveries for the same customer after this many occurrences auto-blacklist the phone.

fields.label: Blacklist Blocks All Payments
fields.description: When off, blacklisted phones are blocked from COD only; online payment orders still pass (but are logged).

fields.label: OpenRouteService API Key
fields.description: Geocoding API key for precise address fraud checks. Get a free key from HeiGIT / OpenRouteService.

fields.label: Default Country
fields.description: Home country used at checkout and for the geocode wrong-country fraud check.

fields.label: Province / State List
fields.description: Comma-separated provinces or states offered in the checkout province box.

fields.default: Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Lahore, Karachi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta, Gujranwala, Gujrat, Sialkot, Hyderabad, Bahawalpur, Sargodha, Jhelum, Wah Cantt, Attock, Abbotabad, Mardan, Kohat, Dera Ghazi Khan, Rahim Yar Khan, Sheikhupura, Jhang, Kasur, Okara, Sahiwal, Wah, Murree, Mirpur, Muzaffarabad, Gilgit, Skardu, Sukkur, Larkana, Nawabshah, Mirpurkhas, Jacobabad, Khairpur, Dadu, Burewala, Chiniot, Khanewal, Vehari, Mandi Bahauddin, Toba Tek Singh
fields.label: City List
fields.description: Comma-separated canonical cities offered in the checkout city box. Cities outside this list add to the fraud score.

fields.label: Provinces & Cities
fields.description: Each row is a province/state with its comma-separated cities. Used for fraud province validation and checkout dropdowns.

fields.label: Require Nearest Landmark
fields.description: Checkout requires a famous landmark so courier riders can find the address.

fields.label: City RTO High Threshold (%)
fields.description: 30-day RTO rate above which a city scores high.

fields.label: City RTO Medium Threshold (%)
fields.description: 30-day RTO rate above which a city scores medium.

fields.label: Fraud Signal Weights
fields.description: JSON of per-signal points. Managed from the Fraud Weights page — leave blank for defaults.

fields.label: Fingerprint Provider
fields.description: Client-side device fingerprinting. ThumbmarkJS (free, no API key), FingerprintJS OSS (free, no API key), CreepJS (free, self-hosted, most signals), or FingerprintJS Pro (paid, requires API key).

fields.label: Fingerprint Public Key
fields.description: Fingerprint Identification browser key. Create an account here. When set, high-value orders are identified server-side for accuracy.

fields.label: Fingerprint Secret Key
fields.description: Server-side API secret used to verify identifications.

fields.label: Fingerprint Region
fields.description: Workspace region shown in your Fingerprint dashboard (us, eu or ap).
Publish products, prices and stock to your Meta catalogue so they appear in WhatsApp and Facebook. Saved products push automatically; Sync now sends everything.
fields.label: Enable Meta Catalog Sync

fields.description: Catalogue ID from Commerce Manager, e.g. 1805695184000731.
fields.label: Meta Catalog ID

fields.description: Graph API access token with catalog_management permission.
fields.label: Meta API Key

fields.description: Optional. Improves discovery, e.g. Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Shirts.
fields.label: Google Product Category
